title: Scan state file versions
description: Changes to the stored shape of the scan state file. Application releases are not recorded here.

entities.title: File names recorded for dedupe
entities.summary: From version 1.1 a scan records every file's path, leaf name and size in a files table; state files from version 1.0 scans have none, and dedupe asks for a new scan.
changes: New table files(path, name, size, cloned) with an index on (name, size), filled by every scan.
status reports the file names recorded and how many were replaced by clones.
A 1.0 state file opened by 1.1 gets an empty files table; dedupe exits with `no file names recorded in this scan state; run new to rescan`.
entities.details: The change was made in the Python predecessor (commit 2dec6fb, which raised its VERSION from 1.0 to 1.1); the Rust port kept the same schema, and the crate's version is 1.1.0. The state file itself stores no version number.
